doc_title: TRANSFER by COMPANIES AND LIMITED LIABILITY PARTNERSHIPS
doc_title_official: TRANSFER by COMPANIES AND LIMITED LIABILITY PARTNERSHIPS
when_used: A company or limited liability partnership that is the registered proprietor transfers its whole interest in a title.

body_text.text: The Transferor as the legal [and beneficial]*** owner HEREBY TRANSFERS all its right title and interest in the above Title.
The Transferor acknowledges receipt of the Consideration.
The Transfer is subject to the provisions of The Land Act 2012,The Land Registration Act 2012, the Lease and the interests noted in the Register of the Title but otherwise free from encumbrances.
The Transferee(s) shall hold the land as joint proprietors/as proprietors in common*** in the following undivided shares:-

foot_notes: Insert full name(s) registration number(s) registered office and address, as applicable.
Insert currency, amount and other consideration.
****The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”

custom_fields.name: undivided_shares
custom_fields.label: Undivided shares
custom_fields.prompt: Where the transferees hold as proprietors in common, the undivided share each takes
